core_obligations: Identify the stable attracting locus with an open part of the Lagrangian attracting variety and establish purity.
Classify the stable unframed factors and apply the local quiver slice to separate ordinary affine and punctual Jordan fibers.

Show, using beta_i and the local crystal construction, precisely which component has all epsilon_i zero; retain the proof rather than giving the answer as background. Prove the rank-one Fock lemma and the general highest-weight component classification, then derive the single-partition delta-shift decomposition for arbitrary framing.

difficulty_reason: The counted MV-cycle theorem has a substantial geometric classification obligation even after the expressly allowed classical crystal, local-slice, root and punctual-fiber inputs. The source must pass from wall stability and stable constituents to the actual Ext-quiver parameters; separate the affine and Jordan factors; identify the attracting configuration locus; show that its full-dimensional irreducible preimages are exactly the highest-weight components; and then recover the partition shifts and the connected highest-weight crystals. This interacting classification supports H3, not merely the terminology or the number of retained lines.

editorial_notes: The only counted claim is Theorem6.2(thm:MV), including the partition-shift crystal decomposition. It does not assert that the geometric fundamental classes are highest-weight vectors: the author explicitly distinguishes crystal-base vectors from fundamental classes at3283–3294. The consequence3432–3441 is not another counted problem.

The notation pi_{zeta,0} in3417 reverses the map indices: the morphism in3396–3401 and the preimage used in3515–3519 are pi_{0,zeta}:M_zeta->M_0. Preserve the original displayed notation and state this contextual reading separately; no author formula is replaced.

The formula1063 occurs in the Harder–Narasimhan prefix argument. The quotient collecting gr_0,...,gr_k is by V^{k+1}, not V^k, under the source filtration convention. Retain the printed formula and require independent disposition of this indexing issue; it is not permission to replace the author proof.

Theorem2.5 recalled944–947 states diffeomorphism to an affine manifold. Source1583 abbreviates this as being affine; the fiber-dimension input is the cited topological argument of Nakajima[Na-quiver,6.11], not an assertion of complex-affineness that would exclude positive-dimensional compact fibers. Independent reader must confirm this precise standard-input scope.
The rank-one Fock proof only uses part(1) of prop:affinestrata; the omitted alternative proof of part(2) at1809–1812 is not an obligation or input of this task.

The open weighted-configuration strata, not the constant-sheaf identification on their closures at2874–2878, are used here. That identification and affine-Levi Theorem5.15 are outside this task and remain separately blocked.

The local core and Fock/MV classification are solution obligations. Only the explicit standard_prerequisites below may be freely invoked. In particular the MV decomposition itself, its highest-weight locus, and the rank-one Fock classification are not prerequisites.

In Z_0^s, the point starts inM_0^s, but existence of its t->infinity limit is tested in the ambientM_0; the limit may lie on a smaller stratum. It is not required to remain inM_0^s. This is the meaning used by the projective-map equality in3396-3401. Preserve the original text and disclose the ambient convention.

The local Cartan entry is(v^k)^T C v^l. Hence forv^0=delta-alpha_h andv^i=e_i it is(delta-alpha_h)^T C e_i=-alpha_h^T C e_i. The extra minus in1956 and corresponding positive sign in1957 are inconsistent with1446-1453. The current MV proof uses the local Cartan definition and the explicit affine/Jordan factors2834-2842; it does not use a positive off-diagonal Cartan entry. Retain the printed formulas and identify this sign slip separately.

The regularity used at2455 means that the relevant semisimplified image has only coordinate-simpleS_i unframed factors. This holds for the application insideLa_zeta=pi_(0,zeta)^(-1)(0). Do not infer the lemma for every point of the smoothM_zeta merely because it iszeta-stable. For Thm6.2 strata carrying nonzero-delta simples, use the affine/Jordan local fiber description and the stated classical crystal structure, as in the final proof; do not apply2434 as a blanket0-stability test.
